label: Mock intervention knowledge
note: Placeholder knowledge for the prototype, written the way the Basel research stream would: what it is, why, mechanisms, requirements, constraints, examples, sources. No execution operations and no layout. Requirements are placeholders, not engineering rules.

interventions.label: Depave
interventions.description: Remove sealing from part of a paved surface and plant it.
state_changes: part of the surface becomes planted soil
parking bays on the depaved area are lost
constraints: Loss of parking or walking space

basel_examples.label: Basel tests surfaces for depaved parking spaces (2022)

interventions.label: Permeable parking
interventions.description: Replace sealed parking paving with a permeable system while keeping the parking use.
state_changes: a storage layer below the surface
constraints: Water quality of runoff from vehicles

interventions.label: Curb cut
interventions.description: Open the kerb so runoff from the road flows into a rain garden or tree trench instead of the gully.
state_changes: runoff is redirected away from the gully into a planted receiving element
constraints: De-icing salt and pollutants from roads

sources.label: NACTO Urban Street Stormwater Guide: bioretention inlet design (curb inlets, slope, blockage)
Sustainable Technologies (STEP) LID SWM Planning and Design Guide: Inlets — curb cuts
sources.note: "Curb cuts are breaks along the length of a curb system to allow water to flow into a LID/BMP." Ontario guidance, not Swiss.

interventions.label: Tree trench (Baumrigole)
interventions.description: A connected trench of structural substrate for a street tree that takes runoff from the surrounding paving.
state_changes: the surrounding paving drains into the trench
a young tree, canopy grows over years
overflow stays connected to the existing drain

sources.label: ZHAW project 74640: vegetation building blocks for Basel streets

interventions.label: Rain garden
interventions.description: A shallow planted depression that collects runoff from nearby paving and lets it soak in or evaporate.
state_changes: part of the surface becomes a planted depression
overflow stays connected to the existing drain

interventions.label: Green roof
interventions.description: Planted substrate on a flat roof. Holds back and evaporates part of the rain; roof drainage stays connected.

basel_examples.label: Basel-Stadt: flat roofs must be greened (§ 72 BPG); mandatory from 10 m² roof area for new builds and renovations, extensive build-up
basel_examples.note: Stadtgärtnerei Basel-Stadt, 'Stadtnatur fördern'. Substrate ≥ 15 cm, ≥ 20 cm on one third of the roof. Checked 3 October 2026.
